title: Progressive growing of patch size: Curriculum learning for accelerated and improved medical image segmentation
mechanism: Start training with small patches and grow them, scaling batch size inversely to keep FLOPs; better convergence on severe foreground imbalance, lower seed variance.
adaptation: 2D: random crops 128 (batch 128) to 256 (batch 32) to 512 (batch 8), equal steps per stage, crops anywhere on the cell; last stage long because inactive and edge_dark need whole-cell context.
min_experiment: Arm: PF with PGPS, 5 seeds. Baseline: SUP100-PF. Metric: crack relF1@2, crack IoU, inactive IoU, seed std. Kill: no co-primary gain and seed std not lower.
evidence: R (abstract): +1.28% relative Dice over 15 3D tasks at equal FLOPs, better on all 15, largest on lesion tasks, lower variance. MICCAI 2024 version had code at github.com/compai-lab/2024-miccai-fischer per web search (contents not checked).
prior_overlap: BRIEF section 5: 2x resolution tested, crop curricula never. Open.
